entities.name: Gothenburg Natural History Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Museum of Gothenburg is a local history museum located in the city centre of Gothenburg in western Sweden. It is located in the East India House, originally built as the Swedish East India Company offices in 1762. The city museum was established in 1861.
